description: This file defines the LocationAttributeType class, which is an entity representing a user-defined extension to the Location class within the OpenMRS platform. It includes field mappings and annotations for ORM, and implements interfaces and methods for handling location attribute types.

classes.name: LocationAttributeType
classes.description: A class representing a location attribute type, which extends BaseAttributeType and implements AttributeType, providing ORM mappings and identification methods for location attribute types.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the LocationAttributeType, delegating to getLocationAttributeTypeId().

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the LocationAttributeType, delegating to setLocationAttributeTypeId().

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: setLocationAttributeTypeId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the LocationAttributeType.
